تشترطون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِطُونَ (taštariṭūna) /taʃ.ta.ri.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# تُشْتَرَطُونَ (tuštaraṭūna) /tuʃ.ta.ra.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
